data.narrative:
PAVE Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Julie Böhning and Jérémy Marciacq, who previously co-founded the Gruyère Space Program at EPFL. The company has raised $40M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and approximately 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the most applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($40M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to series A yields an implied valuation of $100M. This reflects the conventional dilution and value-creation pattern observed across similar-stage frontier-tech rounds.

Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without revenue disclosure, which private companies rarely provide. Peer-median analysis is similarly constrained: while 14 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 operate at identical stages or valuation tiers, rendering narrowly filtered comparables unreliable. The triangulated range supports a valuation of $85M to $115M, with a central estimate of $100M. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to operational milestones, competitive positioning within the fragmented launch and satellite services markets, and market timing relative to commercial space demand cycles.
